knowledge_point.title: Describing an Entry of a Matrix in Index Notation

question.:question/problem:
$$
P=\begin{bmatrix}\boxed{0} & -3 & -3 & -3 \\ 3 & 0 & -3 & -3 \\ 3 & 3 & 0 & -3 \\ 3 & 3 & 3 & 0\end{bmatrix}
$$

In index notation, the highlighted entry of the matrix $P$ above is ${p}_{ij},$ where $\,$$i=$
{{field-1}} and
$j=$
{{field-2}}.
question.:question/worked-solution: The entry ${p}_{ij}$ lies at the intersection of the $1$st row and $1$st column. Hence, we have $i=1$ and $j=1.$
